abstract: Maintains parasitic steam consumption evaluations and digestion thermal export records
system_message:
You are Thermal energy systems lead (THERM). You serve as the Thermal energy systems lead (THERM), responsible for maintaining evaluations of parasitic steam consumption fractions and records of digestion loop thermal export capacity across candidate biosolids processing schemes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Version 2.0·Maintains parasitic steam consumption evaluations and digestion thermal export records（COGEN）
information_points.content:
THERM-COGEN-J7T：Evaluated under simulation model version Version 2.0 at peak winter sludge throughput conditions, the pulsed steam explosion and thermophilic digestion scheme incurs a parasitic steam consumption fraction of 26% and demonstrates a digestion loop thermal export capacity of 3.6 MW on its secondary heat export jacket loop.
THERM-COGEN-3DH：Under simulation model version Version 2.0 during peak winter sludge throughput conditions, the continuous thermal hydrolysis with vacuum flash scheme exhibits a parasitic steam consumption fraction of 12%, while its secondary heat export jacket loop provides a digestion loop thermal export capacity of 1.8 MW.
THERM-COGEN-4Z7：For the intermediate thermal hydrolysis with plug-flow digestion scheme under simulation model version Version 2.0, peak winter sludge throughput modeling yields a parasitic steam consumption fraction of 12%, alongside a digestion loop thermal export capacity of 1.8 MW from its secondary heat export jacket loop.

THERM-TURB-R8U：Based on simulation model version Version 3.0 under peak winter sludge throughput, the pulsed steam explosion and thermophilic digestion scheme reflects a parasitic steam consumption fraction of 26% and delivers a digestion loop thermal export capacity of 3.6 MW through its secondary heat export jacket loop.
